title: Finding a way
odia: ଇଛା ଥିଲେ ଉପାୟ ବଳେ ବଳେ ଆସେ ।
literal_meaning: If there is a wish, a way comes of itself.
explanation: Determination can encourage someone to search for a workable approach. The saying offers encouragement, not a guarantee that desire removes every obstacle.
meaning_odia: ଇଚ୍ଛା ଥିଲେ ମଣିଷ ଉପାୟ ଖୋଜିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରେ। ତେବେ କେବଳ ଇଚ୍ଛା ରହିଲେ ସବୁ ବାଧା ଦୂର ହେବ ବୋଲି ଧରିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A learner finds a shared library copy when buying a book is difficult. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The recorded wording is explained here without assigning an inventor, date or place of origin.
